mapper.select:
SELECT B.VALUATION FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION B LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT C ON B.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND B.FINPROD_TYPE2 = C.FINPROD_TYPE2
C.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND B.VAL_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{netDate},'%Y-%m-%d')

select tpd.TRADE_ID tradeId, tpda.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, IFNULL(pt.PORTFOLIO_ID, tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID) portfolioId, tpd.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, tpd.SHARE_AMT shareAmt from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda on tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID
left join ptl_trade pt on pt.BUSI_NO = tpd.TRADE_ID and pt.PORTFOLIO_ID != tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID
where tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} order by tpd.create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PTL_TRADE SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID, concat_ws('', BUSI_NO, 'R'), BUSI_TABLE, BUSI_ID, BUSI_TYPE, INV_AIM, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, SETTLE_DATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, NOW(), UPDATE_USER, NOW() FROM PTL_TRADE WHERE BUSI_NO = #{tradeId}
